_comment_tokens: Access tokens are short-lived; the frontend silently refreshes. SSO session idle 30 min, max 10 h.
_comment_bruteforce: Keycloak gives you lockout for free — GIVT's hand-rolled auth had none.
_comment_roles: These mirror GIVT's Role enum exactly. Peer is absent by design — it is a Student capability held in the app database, not an identity role.
